news.headline: Launching S1VE X SQUADONE STORE
news.title: Launching S1VE X SQUADONE STORE
news.excerpt: New S1VE x Squad One apparel drop is now live. Grab the GTA VI Edition and exclusive oversized jerseys.
news.content: New S1VE x Squad One apparel drop is now live. Grab the GTA VI Edition and exclusive oversized jerseys with 280 GSM heavy cotton construction.

news.headline: Squad One Partners with eWave for National League Season 2
news.excerpt: Official tournament brackets, live telemetry, and anti-cheat tracking integrated with eWave platform.
news.content: Squad One Esports is proud to announce a landmark strategic partnership with eWave.gg, bringing next-generation automated bracket operations, live killfeed overlays, and real-time player telemetry to Indian competitive PUBG PC.

news.headline: Grand Finals 16 Teams Confirmed: ₹1,50,000 Prize Pool
news.excerpt: Top 16 squads battle across 3 days, 15 matches for the ultimate title.
news.content: After fierce qualifiers featuring 95 registered teams, the top 16 survivors have booked their ticket to the Squad One National League Grand Finals. Matches will be broadcast live across Erangel, Miramar, Taego, and Rondo.

news.headline: 🚨 THE NEXT STEP FOR OUR SCRIMS! SA CROSS-BAY SCRIMS
news.title: 🚨 THE NEXT STEP FOR OUR SCRIMS! SA CROSS-BAY SCRIMS
news.excerpt: India Scrims are officially evolving to South Asia Cross-Bay Scrims with SEA guest squads.
news.content: India Scrims are officially evolving to South Asia Cross-Bay Scrims! Regular domestic tournaments continue uninterrupted, with SA Cross-Bay as an additional competitive proving ground alongside SEA guest squads.

news.headline: 🔥 THE STAGE IS SET! Nations League Season 3 Announced
news.title: 🔥 THE STAGE IS SET! Nations League Season 3 Announced
news.excerpt: Top squads lock in for supreme dominance this November 2026. Stay tuned for registration!
news.content: The SquadOne PUBG PC Nations League Season 3 is officially on the horizon! Top squads in the region lock in for ultimate glory and supreme dominance in November 2026.

news.headline: The Future of SA & SEA PUBG is in Your Hands
news.title: The Future of SA & SEA PUBG is in Your Hands
news.excerpt: Forming the player-led eWave Executive Body for SA & SEA to decide tournament rules & formats.
news.content: Forming the eWave Executive Body for SA & SEA — an elite, player-led council giving the community total authority over tournament rules, formats, and regional development.

news.headline: - LIVE NOW! - SquadOne & eWave Loyalty Program
news.title: - LIVE NOW! - SquadOne & eWave Loyalty Program
news.excerpt: Earn points toward exclusive Mystery Gifts every time you watch our official livestreams.
news.content: Unlock exclusive rewards! Earn points toward an exclusive Mystery Gift every time you subscribe, chat, and watch our official live streams. Start earning your rewards today!

news.headline: Executive Body Application Update: Deadline Sunday
news.title: Executive Body Application Update: Deadline Sunday
news.excerpt: Direct ascension to eWave Founding Council. Applications close this Sunday at Midnight!
news.content: Overwhelming response for the SA & SEA Executive Body! Direct ascension to the General Founding Council of eWave with global decision-making power. Applications close this Sunday at Midnight.
